title: NRO founded for reconnaissance in denied airspace
summary: UAPGerb tells of NRO founded for reconnaissance in denied airspace, about Cold War at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: The NRO was founded to get American intelligence in denied airspaces because we knew that nuclear war with the Soviets would lead to mutually assured destruction.

plain: A researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells podcast host Jesse Michels that the National Reconnaissance Office, the US agency behind spy satellites, was created to gather intelligence over places American planes could not safely fly, such as the Soviet Union. He says this mattered because everyone knew a nuclear war with the Soviets would destroy both sides, so seeing what the other side was doing was vital.
